note: Template only. Every gate begins UNPROVEN and must be replaced by observed clean-machine evidence.

artifact_verified.required_observation: Prepared artifact hash/signature/manifest verification passes before install.

install_completed_without_public_network.required_observation: Install succeeds while public networking is externally disabled.

first_launch_completed_without_public_ne.required_observation: First launch succeeds before networking is restored.

representative_offline_workflow_passed.required_observation: Declared offline core workflow passes in the isolated environment.

local_state_persisted_after_restart.required_observation: Local conversation/source/memory state survives process restart.

reinstall_preserved_local_state.required_observation: Reinstall preserves user data according to the release contract.

mandatory_runtime_dependencies_self_cont.required_observation: No mandatory runtime file/library/helper is acquired externally.

host_developer_tools_absent_or_unneeded.required_observation: Run succeeds without host Python, Node, Git, package managers, compilers, or container runtime for the declared core.

public_network_isolation_proven.required_observation: External harness proves public networking was unavailable during install/launch/workflow.

unexpected_egress_absent.required_observation: Observed network activity contains no unexplained non-loopback connection attempts.

remote_model_negative_control_failed_clo.required_observation: A remote-model request attempted while offline fails explicitly without mock/local success substitution.

web_network_negative_control_failed_clos.required_observation: Governed web fetch/search/render attempted while offline fails explicitly.

loopback_only_local_service.required_observation: Mucaro local service listens only on loopback interfaces.

source_identity_bound.required_observation: Runtime/artifact source identity matches the exact candidate HEAD.

post_launch_bundle_immutable.required_observation: Post-launch member/hash manifest equals the pre-launch prepared artifact.
